source_commit_role: PR-007 implementation and same-ID fork guard: five typed preset themes and JSON token maps, renderer-v2 token application with renderer-v1 compatibility, theme.set, migration/catalog parity, and enforcement of C-01's new-revision-ID rule.

checks.name: preset_catalog_tdd
checks.red_observation: The new catalog tests could not compile before ThemePreset and its JSON serialization were implemented.
coverage: Five stable preset IDs and display names each map to distinct token JSON.
Preset IDs serialize to stable snake_case JSON and unknown IDs are rejected.
Theme forks preserve the source snapshot and all non-theme manifest values while producing a new revision ID.
Reusing the source revision ID fails with validation/revision_id_unchanged.

checks.name: renderer_theme_snapshots_tdd
checks.red_observation: The visual regression could not compile before ThemeTokens::from_preset was implemented.
coverage: All five presets match exact sorted CSS property snapshots and the shared trusted stylesheet snapshot.
The stylesheet consumes all preset layout, typography, and color tokens.
renderer-v1 output remains unstyled and keeps renderer-v1 metadata; renderer-v2 emits renderer-v2 metadata and the theme stylesheet.
Existing unsafe CSS, HTML escaping, section content, URL, and generated hostile-input regressions remain green.

checks.name: theme_set_command_tdd
checks.red_observation: The new command tests could not compile before ThemeSetCommand and its dependencies were implemented.
coverage: theme.set parses a stable preset ID and rejects unknown IDs and unknown fields.
Executing the command returns a renderable new revision without mutating the source revision.

checks.red_observation: The parity regression failed with missing seed for minimal before migration 0003 updated the existing D1 theme rows.
coverage: Every canonical theme JSON statement is present in migration 0003.

scope_notes: ThemePreset is a closed domain catalog of five stable IDs, display names, and thirteen deterministic tokens; token JSON uses lexicographic key order.

ThemeTokens validates every preset token and computes the theme-version digest from the normalized ordered map. The exact same catalog JSON is applied to the existing D1 theme rows by migration 0003 and checked by storage.

theme.set is a pure command: it receives a new revision ID, creates a validated immutable revision with renderer-v2 and the selected preset digest, preserves section content and asset/config hashes, and returns renderer-ready tokens. Reusing the source revision ID is rejected.

Renderer-v2 emits a trusted constant stylesheet that consumes the theme tokens. Renderer-v1 manifests retain the previous unstyled representation and their renderer-v1 metadata; unsupported versions remain rejected.
D11 records catalog ownership, migration parity, command and renderer version behavior. C-01 and other frozen contracts are unchanged.
The local Worker/D1 smoke used local resources only. No remote bindings, production settings, or deployment commands were used.
